lattice.note: Position index k is the k-th eighth note of a two-bar span. Position 0 is beat_grid[0]; it is NOT claimed to be a bar downbeat (Section 4 removes downbeat identification). See residual risk R1.

metrical_strength_convention.note: Authored with the mask, never derived from a detected downbeat (Section 5). The convention used across this inventory: lattice positions 0 and 8 STRONG, 4 and 12 MEDIUM, other on-beat positions (2, 6, 10, 14) MEDIUM, off-beat eighths WEAK.
metrical_strength_convention.design_property: The two mirror pairs (M5/M6 and M7/M8) were authored so that their metrical-strength SEQUENCES are identical while their interval sequences are opposite. Score_B therefore cannot vary between the two contexts of a trial, which is what makes 'the only thing that changes between contexts is the accompaniment' (Section 1) true of the scorer and not merely of the audio.
